purpose: Teach: 異端/卑怯/束縛/醜い/人為/援護/邪悪/監獄

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、宗教史における異端の扱いを論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on how heresy was treated throughout religious history.
lines.style: Warm professional inquiry. Gentle opening — not testing, genuinely curious. Measured pace. Slight upward lift at the end, inviting her to expand.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦争中の卑怯な戦法を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on cowardly military tactics during wartime.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Direct eye contact implied. Steady pace without rush. A student who has thought through her choice and stands by it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 女性を束縛してきた法律史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You explored the legal history of how women have been restricted.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slight weight on the words. Not accusatory — reflective, almost turning it over in her mind. Pause before 'restricted,' as if the word matters.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の醜い差別表現を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined the ugly discriminatory language used against civilians during wartime.
lines.style: Firm and clear. No apology in her voice. Speaking as someone who has stared directly at something difficult and won't look away.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 人為的な災害の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you wrote about the history of human-made disasters.
lines.style: Engaged, present. Slight nod in the voice. She's tracking the pattern, genuinely interested in where this student goes with difficult subjects.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、市民を援護する諸団体を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I looked at the various organizations that support and advocate for civilians.
lines.style: Calm assertion. A slight recovery in tone — lighter than before, but still grounded. She's chosen something harder and found something that matters.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 邪悪と評された人物史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You examined the history of figures condemned as evil.
lines.style: Even-keeled, slightly wondering. Not leading her — genuinely curious how she approached this. Reflective pause, like turning a key.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、近代の監獄制度を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I studied the modern penal system and its development.
lines.style: Quiet finality. She has said what she came to say. Steady, grounded, not defensive. Eyes forward. A period, not a question mark.
